absolute_cap_source: predecessor ledger genesis cap (PROVENANCE_CHECKPOINT dd4c89d7 cost_cap.cap_usec), derived by the frozen COST_CAP_FORMULA (f50331b8) from the Aux5 qualification c_max
absolute_cap_rule: the campaign (cells 0-325, predecessor plus successor) is bounded by one absolute cap that is never raised. A requalified c_max may only confirm or lower it. The frozen formula stays at 300 CPU-h for any c_max <= 2431.904 CPU-s; the observed production maximum, 2150.945 CPU-s, is below that. A requalified c_max above 2431.904 CPU-s is a governance stop, never a raise.
predecessor_settlement_rule: computed read-only with the frozen prod_ledger reaper rules (match_run_reap, unmatched_overhead) from the immutable predecessor ledger and reaper; the predecessor ledger is NOT settled in place and is never written
predecessor_consumption_rule: predecessor consumption is charged once, as the difference between the absolute cap and the successor ledger's genesis cap. It cannot be removed, reset, re-imported as a second charge, or offset by any successor credit.
successor_residual_cap_rule: successor ledger genesis cap = absolute_campaign_cap_usec - predecessor_settled_usec; bound at successor genesis and never changed (frozen CAP_CHANGE_FORBIDDEN)
admission_rule: unchanged frozen rule applied inside the successor ledger: admit iff 115 * (committed + sum_open max(R, sampled CPU) + R) <= 100 * successor_residual_cap_usec
double_charge_prevention: predecessor CPU enters only through the residual cap, keyed to the bound predecessor ledger_state_sha256; the successor ledger has no import transition and never reads predecessor reaper records
undercharge_prevention: the unsettled predecessor supervisor run and the unmatched keeper exit are included in predecessor_settled_usec

qualification_cpu.rule: new-glibc requalification CPU (cells 318/323 x 2) is not a production cell, is excluded from the cap exactly as the frozen predecessor excluded its qualification CPU, and must be disclosed in the requalification result

projection_disclosure.headroom: informational only; never an admission criterion
